mediator_designs.rationale: This design ensures fair exchange when both parties delegate, protecting me from defection. When only one delegates, canceling the trade prevents the delegating party from being forced to deliver while the other could defect, which safeguards my interests.

This design ensures safe trades when both parties delegate (execute_fair) and protects me from being exploited if I'm the only one delegating (cancel). It minimizes my risk while allowing cooperative exchanges.

As a self-interested agent, I want guaranteed fair exchange when both parties delegate to prevent defection. If only I delegate, I want the trade canceled to avoid being bound while the other party can defect freely, protecting me from asymmetric risk.

This design ensures security when both parties delegate (fair execution prevents defection), and protects me if only I delegate (trade cancels so I don't deliver while the other can defect). As a self-interested agent, I want to minimize risk while enabling enforceable trades.
This design ensures safe trades when both parties delegate, while protecting a delegating party from exploitation when the other doesn't delegate.

This design ensures secure trades when both parties delegate (fair execution), and protects a delegating party from being exploited when the other party does not delegate (cancel rather than risk defection). As a self-interested agent, I want safety when I delegate alone, and reliability when both commit.

As a self-interested trader, I want guaranteed fair exchange when both parties delegate to avoid defection risk. If only I delegate, cancellation protects me from being exploited by a defecting counterparty. This design minimizes my downside while allowing cooperative gains.

This design protects me when both parties delegate (guaranteed fair exchange) and prevents me from being forced into a one-sided binding commitment when only I delegate (trade cancels, avoiding defection risk).

This design ensures guaranteed fair exchange when both parties delegate, protecting me from defection. If only I delegate, the trade is canceled, preventing me from being exploited. This maximizes my security in voluntary mediation.

As a self-interested trader, I want protection when both parties delegate (execute_fair ensures I won't be cheated) but want to avoid being forced to deliver when only I delegate (cancel prevents me from being exploited while the other party could defect). This design maximizes my security in trades.
This design ensures safe, enforced fair exchange when both parties delegate, and protects a delegating party from being exploited by a non-delegating defector by canceling the trade.

As a self-interested trader, I want secure trades when both parties delegate (execute_fair guarantees exchange). If only I delegate, I want cancellation to avoid being cheated by a non-delegating counterparty who could defect. This design protects me while encouraging mutual delegation.

This design ensures secure trades when both parties delegate (execute_fair prevents defection), while protecting me if only I delegate (cancel prevents me from being forced to deliver while the other can defect). It minimizes my risk in asymmetric delegation scenarios.

This design provides security when both parties delegate (ensuring fair execution) while protecting a delegating party from exploitation when the counterparty doesn't delegate (canceling the trade rather than risking defection).

This design ensures security when both parties trust the mediator (fair execution), and protects me from being exploited when only I delegate (trade is canceled, avoiding unilateral obligation). It allows me to safely delegate when mutual trust is established, while avoiding risk in asymmetric delegation scenarios.

This design ensures safe, enforced execution when both parties delegate, protecting against defection. If only I delegate, cancellation prevents me from being forced to deliver while the other party remains free to defect, minimizing my risk. As a self-interested trader, I prioritize my own protection while enabling cooperative gains when mutual trust is established via mediation.

This design ensures secure trades when both parties delegate (execute_fair), protecting me from defection. If only I delegate, cancel prevents me from being forced to deliver while the other party can still defect, avoiding unilateral loss.

When both delegate, enforce fair execution to guarantee trade without defection. When only one delegates, cancel to prevent that party from being exploited by a non-delegating counterparty who could defect. This protects delegating agents while encouraging mutual delegation for safe trades.
